title: Counit-normalized coherent shifts on scalar extension
statement: For any family p of the universal derived scalar-extension presentations of def-pur-ringed-coefficient-projection-data, there exists a coherent integer CommShift structure on each p(a).derived for which p(a).counit is a shift-compatible natural transformation. The normalization is by that very universal counit; no ring map is required to be flat.

source.place: Derived Categories, Tag 05SU; universal right-Kan-extension shift construction.

proof.text: The additive ordinary scalar functor induces a coherent termwise shift on its homotopy functor; Qh has its canonical coherent shift. The universal scalar left-derived pair is a right Kan extension along Qh. Apply the right-Kan coherent-shift theorem to every coefficient map. Its uniqueness supplies zero and addition coherence and the counit shift equation simultaneously.
